scope: Miao Chapter 13 (pp. 415-454): the event tree and Assumption 13.1.1, Pareto optima (Proposition 13.2.1), Arrow-Debreu equilibrium and the welfare theorems (Theorems 13.3.1-13.3.2), Radner equilibrium with debt constraints, no-arbitrage and state prices, complete markets (Theorems 13.4.1-13.4.3), equivalence of equilibria (Theorem 13.5.1), asset price bubbles (Theorem 13.6.1, Kocherlakota and Werner examples), recursive equilibrium, asset pricing (Hansen-Jagannathan, CAPM, CCAPM), and Exercises 1-10.
source: Jianjun Miao, Economic Dynamics in Discrete Time, MIT Press 2014 (draft of 21 April 2013), Chapter 13
